notes: New rule type proposed: award_presumption_max_threshold (presumption of maximum award below a dollar threshold). Rule 21F-6(c).

applies_to: whether an award is paid once criteria are met (the amount within 10-30% is discretionary)
quote: Awards are required to be made in the amount of 10% to 30% of the monetary sanctions collected.
notes: Awards are mandatory for eligible whistleblowers; the percentage within the range is at the Commission's discretion.

applies_to: amount (percentage within 10-30%) is discretionary
quote: The determination of the amount of an award is in the discretion of the Commission.
notes: Amount discretionary; whether an award is owed to an eligible whistleblower is not (see 2010 row).

applies_to: claim (Form WB-APP) after posting of the Notice of Covered Action
quote: A claimant will have ninety (90) days from the date of the Notice of Covered Action to file a claim for an award

applies_to: time to apply (Form WB-APP) after a Notice of Covered Action is posted
quote: Once a Notice of Covered Action is posted, individuals have 90 calendar days to apply for an award

applies_to: sanctions go to the Investor Protection Fund (rather than Treasury/victims) only while the Fund balance is at or below this level
quote: unless the balance of the Fund at the time the monetary sanction is collected exceeds $300,000,000
notes: New rule type proposed: fund_replenishment_threshold.

applies_to: SEC may pay an award on another agency's related action even if that agency has its own programme, if that programme is not comparable or the total award could not exceed $5 million
quote: The Commission will make an award on the other action if the other agency's whistleblower program is not comparable to the Commission's or if the total amount awarded could not exceed $5 million.
notes: New rule type proposed: related_action_other_program_cap. Report footnote 12: Whistleblower Program Rules, Release No. 34-9560 (Aug. 26, 2022) [as printed], effective October 3, 2022.

applies_to: covered judicial or administrative action (must exceed)
quote: results in monetary sanctions exceeding $1,000,000

applies_to: monetary sanctions imposed in the covered action (must exceed)
quote: successful Commission enforcement actions resulting in the imposition of monetary sanctions over $1,000,000

applies_to: all rewards in a calendar year, unless waived by the President
quote: the total amount of rewards paid pursuant to this section may not exceed $25 million in any calendar year
notes: Proposed new rule name 'annual_award_cap' (programme-wide yearly ceiling).

applies_to: per reward, unless the Secretary personally authorizes more and notifies Congress
quote: No reward paid under this section may exceed $5 million, unless the Secretary
pay a reward to any individual, if that individual furnishes information leading to
notes: The Secretary 'may' pay, with the concurrence of State and the Attorney General.

applies_to: Lacey Act rewards
quote: The amount of the reward, if any, is to be designated by the Secretary or the Secretary of the Treasury, as appropriate.
notes: No percentage set by law; paid from penalties, fines and forfeitures 'beginning in fiscal year 1983'. Other wildlife laws (e.g. Endangered Species Act) have their own reward clauses, not collected here.
